title: pm: land low-risk skills wording on the seat's review (Tier S arm on the catalog rows)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUhUNUU87zF4e1oTQPE9zim)_

Fixes #33501

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pF46HJnpBrhgVWtwV

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:登记表里 `skills/**` 与 `ui/skills/**` 两行仍是 Tier H,但多了一个「低风险技能臂」读数。以下全部成立才读成 Tier S:受管路径只在这两行;这两行下只有 `.md` 与 `evals/*.json`;其余路径只有 changeset 与 `docs/`、`content/docs/` 下的 Markdown 散文;正文恰好一行裸写的 `Clause-②: no` 和一行 `Metadata-protocol: none`(引用、代码块、尾随文字、多行声明都算 H);至少一个 changeset,在 head 读出,只发布 `'@objectstack/skills': patch`,也带这两行;不带 `security` 标签,时间线上也没被摘掉过;不是 fork。合并队列守卫在 merge_group 腿读这些,再要求同 head 的达档复核记录写的是 PASS,席位入队才放行;`--pr` 预检给同一判定。AGENTS.md 第 14 条与 pm-dispatch 两处落地行同步。
- 为什么改:你 2026-11-14 同意把低风险 Tier H 放权给座位(「同意 把低风险的 Tier H 放权给座位」「把低风险的 Tier H 放权给座位，立 p1 卡优化」);现在座位入队技能措辞 PR 会被必需检查 Governed Surface Queue Guard 弹出。
- 风险与回滚:上面任一条不成立或读不到(正文、标签、时间线、changeset、fork 判定),一律仍是 Tier H(失败即关);复核记录是 FAIL 或没写结论也拒。CODEOWNERS、`--test`、`--branch` 与中继请审照旧按路径读 H。`docs/adr/**` 不动,仍 Tier H,ADR 那一半由 #33539 承接。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` 的 `lowRiskArmVerdict` 与 `readBareDeclaration`;`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 的 `readLowRiskTier` 与 `lowRiskRecordVerdict`;AGENTS.md 第 14 条 Tier S 括号。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 33394`,预期 exit 3、`Tier S(席内达档复核落地)` 与 `low-risk skills arm ... Tier S` 一行。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 改 `AGENTS.md`,本身是 Tier H:请合并(或批准后由席位落地)。

## What changes

- **The register (`scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`).** The `skills-catalog` and `ui-skills-catalog` rows keep `tier: H` and gain `lowRisk` (scoped to objectstack), modelled on the workflows split: a READING moves them, the row does not. `lowRiskArmVerdict(matched, repo, reading)` reads Tier S only when ALL of these hold, each a printed reason when it does not:
  - every governed row hit is a catalog row;
  - every changed path lies under a hit catalog row or matches `LOW_RISK_RIDER_PATTERNS` (a `.changeset/*.md`, or Markdown prose under `docs/` or `content/docs/`), and every path under a catalog row is `.md` or `evals/*.json` (`LOW_RISK_ARM_FILE_PATTERNS`);
  - the body carries exactly one bare `Clause-②: no` and one bare `Metadata-protocol: none`. `readBareDeclaration` runs the fleet's own readers (`readClause2Line`, `readMetadataProtocolLine`) line by line, never a second parser: a second declaration, trailing words, an arm, or the line quoted or inside a fence is H;
  - at least one changeset, each read at the head, whose frontmatter releases nothing but `'@objectstack/skills': patch` (an empty frontmatter is allowed) and whose body carries the same two bare lines (`lowRiskChangesetReasons`);
  - the labels were read and none is `security`, and the timeline was read and has no `unlabeled` event for `security`;
  - `forkVerdict` of the pull object reads a same-repository head.

  No reading, or an unmeasured one, is Tier H with its reason. `applyLowRiskArm` runs after `applyWorkflowSplit`, so a split workflow row beside a catalog path counts as a governed row outside the arm. `governedTierFor` and `testVerdict` take the reading as one more optional argument; every caller that passes none answers exactly as before (catalog paths Tier H). `renderLowRiskLines` prints the arm's verdict. `--pr` builds the reading from the pull object and file walk it already fetches (`pullLowRiskReading`), plus the timeline over the same channel (`fetchTimelineOver`, only when a catalog path is hit, every page or NOT MEASURED) and each changeset at the PR's head from this checkout (`pullChangesetReading`, NOT MEASURED with the fetch that cures it when the head is not here). `--test` and `--branch` have no body and say NOT MEASURED. The header section "The low-risk skills arm" lists the conditions.
- **The queue guard (`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`).** `decomposeGovernedWork` keeps `allPaths` (every path of every attributed commit of the PR, collected before the governed filter drops a row) and `changesetRefs` (each changeset with the commit that touched it, ungoverned commits included). The entry reads the arm NOT MEASURED there; the `pull_request` leg prints Tier H with that note and never reddens. On `merge_group`, `readLowRiskTier` re-reads each catalog entry's tier through the register's `governedTierFor` with: the body, label names and `forkVerdict` of the pull object the leg already fetched (`makePullReader` now returns `labels` and `fork`); the timeline the enqueue leg already read (kept, not re-fetched; an unread or failed timeline is NOT MEASURED); and each changeset by `git show <commit>:<path>`. Then the Tier S record leg runs, and for an entry the arm put at Tier S the same-head record must also READ PASS: `lowRiskRecordVerdict` reads the comment the locator chose with the fleet's `contractReviewVerdictOf`. FAIL, no verdict word, or no reader loaded is a refusal (`not-pass`) with its own line. A record carried from an older head (the regeneration and prose-only carry) stands for the arm only when the hops, diffed with the leg's git reader (`--no-renames`, so a rename lists both paths), moved no `.changeset/` path and no path under a catalog row (the carry admits both as prose, yet the arm reads its tier from them); an unreadable diff refuses. The other Tier S legs are unchanged and still read no verdict (#33541).
- **`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`.** Re-exports `contractReviewVerdictOf` from `check-half-states.mjs` (already its import), so the guard's lazy loader reaches the fleet's one verdict reader. One import name and one export line.
- **`AGENTS.md` Prime Directive 14.** The surface list drops "all Tier H"; Tier H is "every register row outside Tier S"; Tier S names `.claude/**` and the objectstack workflow edits and skills-only wording the register reads as S (`readWorkflowDiff`, `lowRiskArmVerdict`). The detail lives in the script header, per AGENTS.md's own rule. Net content is 13 bytes shorter; the paragraph is re-wrapped at the 120-byte budget and keeps its 16 lines (AGENTS.md 1050 to 1050).
- **pm-dispatch.** `SKILL.md`: "路径面命中 Tier H" becomes "定档 Tier H", and the workflows line names both readings and keeps the workflow Tier H triggers (`readWorkflowDiff`(发布面/C2/拒读⇒H),技能 `lowRiskArmVerdict`,未读⇒H), within the 120-byte line budget. `references/lanes/skills.md`: the pre-arm check is `check-governed-merges --pr N` (only `--pr` can read the arm). The other places the card and comment 6885437809 listed were read and still hold as written: `contract-review.md` 16 and 51 and `landing-operations.md` 12 and 89 speak of Tier S and Tier H generically, `execution-duties.md` 17's soft cap already counts only PRs that stay Tier H, and `coordinator.md` names no tier.

## Why

Ruling-ref: Leehom, project chat 2026-11-14, verbatim 「同意 把低风险的 Tier H 放权给座位」, then 「把低风险的 Tier H 放权给座位，立 p1 卡优化」. Measured on `origin/main` f068cde8: `GOVERNED_SURFACES` put `skills/**` at Tier H, and the guard's `merge_group` leg passes a Tier H entry only on an authorized approval or enqueue (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`), so a seat enqueue of a skills wording PR is refused. Comment 6885437809 measured that the ruleset requires no review (PRs merged with zero reviews), so the guard is the only stop and no settings change is owed.

## Acceptance notes

- **`docs/adr/**` stays Tier H.** The ruling names ADR notes, but a path cannot tell a note from a changed decision. #33539 carries the ADR half of the ruling (an add-only note reading).
- **The relay's review plan still summons the approvers** (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` `governedReviewPlan` reads paths only): a summons, not a block. Follow-up #33540.
- **The other Tier S legs of the queue guard still read no verdict** (`.claude/**`, the workflow split): only the low-risk arm requires PASS here. Follow-up #33541.
- **PD 14 does not quote the ruling or list the conditions** (review nit N1, not taken). `AGENTS.md`'s own rule allows no ruling date or quotation there (provenance cites a ruling record), and its line ceiling has no headroom. The conditions and the ruling live in the script header and the `lowRiskArmVerdict` docblock, which PD 14 names.
- **`--test` and `--branch` always read the arm NOT MEASURED** (they have no PR body); the seat's pre-arm check for a skills PR is `--pr N`.
- **Shared file with #33484:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (two different lines). Whichever lands second merges `origin/main`.
- **Live readings** on two PRs waiting for a click: `--pr 33394` and `--pr 33482` both still read Tier S through the tightened arm (timeline, fork and changesets read; head fetched locally). They still need a same-head `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS record before the seat enqueues, and they can only use the arm once this PR is on `main`.

## Verification

Head `e2b1cabc` (after the at-tier reviews 6886787995, 6887175399 and 6887454202: the carried-record fix, `--no-renames` on its diff, then the real-git case detached from the caller's `GIT_` environment; branch merged with `origin/main`).

<details><summary>Self-tests of the edited scripts</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 670 assertions. Battery "⚖️ the low-risk skills arm" now 54 cases (floor pinned at 54), pinning each review item: M1 (no changeset; changesets unread; another package, `minor`/`major`, or a second release line; changeset missing or annotating either declaration; no frontmatter; not readable at the head; a changed changeset the reading holds no file for; body without a bare `Metadata-protocol: none`; the catalog at patch in either quote or an empty frontmatter is S), S1 (`unlabeled` security in any case; another label removed stays S; timeline unread or not a list; `--pr` reads the timeline only when a catalog path is hit), S2 (trailing words; two declarations, even two `no`; a quoted or fenced `no` before a real `yes`, backtick and tilde fences; a lone fenced or quoted `no`; a closed fence before the real line stays S), S3 (fork; deleted head repo; unread fork predicate), S4 (`.js`, `.json` outside `evals/`, nested `evals/sub/*.json`, `.yaml`, `.png`, `.sh` are H; `evals/*.json` is S), plus `pullChangesetReading` and `lowRiskRowHit`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 477 cases. Battery "⚖️ the low-risk skills arm at the queue" now 44 cases (floor 44), end to end through `runGuard` on `merge_group`: the PASS clear; a PASS record carried over a docs-only hop clears, while one carried over a hop that rewrote the changeset or moved a skill's `CHANGELOG.md` is refused, as is a carried record whose hops cannot be diffed; the carry check's diff carries `--no-renames` (argument pinned), and on a real temporary repository (every git call under `gitFreeEnv()` with `-c commit.gpgsign=false`; the self-test also passes with `GIT_DIR` set to a bogus path) a skill renamed out of the catalog into `content/docs/` refuses the carried record while the plain diff names only the destination; a same-head FAIL record, a record with no verdict word, a newer FAIL behind an older PASS, and a recogniser set without the verdict reader are each refused (`not-pass`); `**VERDICT: PASS**` clears; a non-arm Tier S entry with a FAIL record still stands (unchanged, #33541); M1, S1, S2, S3, S4 each H with a valid PASS record (changeset in another commit of the PR included; no git reader; a timeline that threw or was never read); `makePullReader` carries the fork predicate.
- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 383 cases.
- Mutation checks (not kept, each restored): dropping the PASS check, ignoring the guard's timeline, ignoring the guard's fork reading, ignoring `unlabeled`, allowing a second declaration, allowing a fenced line, switching S4 off, allowing no changeset, skipping the carried-record check, and dropping `--no-renames` each turn the self-test red.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 47 derived, 47 run, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 47 families on head `e2b1cabc` (`check:pm-record-recognisers` joins for the re-export). Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, after building `@objectstack/lint...` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0). All 47 exit 0. `--ran`: "47 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 47 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

</details>

<details><summary>Tier, governed reading, line budget</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --tier`: MANDATORY contract-review tier, from `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0. `SKILL.md` stays 319 lines; its workflows line is exactly 120 bytes and the tier line says the skills arm is exclusive. `AGENTS.md` stays 1050 lines; PD 14's last eight lines are re-wrapped at the byte budget for "skills-only".
- Live on head `4a459236`: `--pr 33394` and `--pr 33482` read Tier S through the arm with the timeline, fork and changesets read (heads fetched locally).

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI runs it.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing: `scripts/pm/**`, `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`; `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
